title: Schoolchildren at Classroom Holiday Party, 1950s Deckled Snapshot Photo
description: A group of elementary school children gather around a long wooden table during a classroom celebration, likely a Christmas or holiday party in the early 1950s. The children are dressed in patterned sweaters and flannel shirts, unwrapping gifts and enjoying treats, with a glass soda bottle set on a napkin. In the background, two adult women (likely teachers or mothers) observe near a blackboard that has lesson writing chalked onto it. The snapshot features deckled edges and reflects mid-century American school community life.
